annotations.text:
Every page in the chosen system. The river runs the length of each one: it comes out of the mountains in the masthead, down the left gutter, and off the bottom edge below the footer.

Post titles, dates and excerpts are the real ones — the five posts quoted in voice.md plus the finished AirPrint post. The standfirst is bracketed because it has not been written.
The query "swt" and its two hits are a worked example, not fixed copy — those two posts really are the SWT ones. Coral marks the active tag and the matched words.

Structure only. Every bracketed slot is a placeholder — CONTEXT.md says the projects page has no content, priority or structure decided yet, so none was invented. The three candidate names are the ones CONTEXT.md already lists.

390 wide. The metadata rail collapses into a strip under the title, the river thins to 2px against the left edge and drops its label, and the terrain is redrawn rather than scaled — the massif moves right so the river still exits low and left.

No painted status bar: the real one renders on top.

Every value the five page drawings actually use, written down and drawn in the system it describes.

Writing it turned up one real defect: a third grey carried the rail labels, code captions and YAML comments at 2.44:1, well under AA. It is gone from all five pages — that text is muted now, and the hierarchy comes from size, tracking and case instead.

The last block lists what is still open, including the collapsing masthead.

The two directions that were not taken, kept for reference. Restrained treated the map as a hint; Cartographic pushed it to a framed map strip with settlements and a compass rose. The shipped system takes Restrained's palette, layout and metadata rail plus Cartographic's terrain, named river and drop cap.
